title: Candidate estimate program
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\tau\in\mathbb{Q}$ satisfy $0<\tau\leq 1$, and let $J$ and $P$ be sets of coordinates in $\{1,\ldots,n\}$. The candidate estimate program uses membership queries to run the scheduled restricted Fourier-weight estimator for $J$ and the part of $P$ lying in $J$, with the accuracy and confidence parameters specified by $\tau$ and $n$, then returns an estimate record containing $J$, $P$, and the resulting rational estimate.
caveat: The estimator’s accuracy and confidence functions are referenced but not defined in the supplied definitions.
